description: List all namespaces in the cluster.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a NamespaceList envelope whose items are Namespace objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the pods in a given namespace.

namespace.description: The namespace to list pods from.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a PodList envelope whose items are Pod objects; on failure (namespace not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single pod by name within a namespace.

namespace.description: The namespace the pod belongs to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the Pod object; on failure (pod not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a pod by name within a namespace; the returned pod is marked Terminating.

namespace.description: The namespace the pod belongs to.

name.description: The name of the pod to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the deleted Pod object with phase Terminating; on failure (pod not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the deployments in a given namespace.

namespace.description: The namespace to list deployments from.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a DeploymentList envelope whose items are Deployment objects; on failure (namespace not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single deployment by name within a namespace.

namespace.description: The namespace the deployment belongs to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the Deployment object; on failure (deployment not found), output contains an error message.

description: Scale a deployment to a target replica count; available/ready/updated replicas converge to the requested count.

namespace.description: The namespace the deployment belongs to.

name.description: The name of the deployment to scale.

replicas.description: The desired number of replicas (clamped to a minimum of 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Scale object reflecting the new replica count; on failure (deployment not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the services in a given namespace.

namespace.description: The namespace to list services from.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a ServiceList envelope whose items are Service objects; on failure (namespace not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all nodes in the cluster.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a NodeList envelope whose items are Node objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
